posts.cooked:
I don't have Villains, yet, but I think I can predict the number of cards it will have. Anyone want to check my numbers?

NOTE: This is just for the smaller cards, so doesn't include the Vengeance/Villains character cards or the Kismet/Infinitor promos.
 
  • EE - 578 (41x10 + 27x4 + 15x4 = 410 + 108 + 60)
  • RC - 222 (41x2 + 27x4 + 2/Operative + 15x2 = 82 + 108 +2 + 30)
  • IR - 228 (41x2 + 27x4 + 8/Ennead + 15x2 = 82 + 108 +8 + 30)
  • ST - 220 (41x2 + 27x4 + 15x2 = 82 + 108 + 30)
  • Vengeance - 339 (41x5 + 4/Sentinels + 20x5 + 15x2 = 205 +4 + 100 + 30)
  • WC - 224 (41x2 + 2/Sky-Scraper, 27x4 + 2/Kaargra + 15x2 = 82 +2 + 108 +2 + 30)
  • Villains - 260 (20x10 + 15x4 = 200 + 60)
  • Mini-expansions - 276 (41x3 + 27x4 + 15x3 = 123 + 108 + 45)
  • Promo Heroes - 37 (YL-1, RCW-1, Ra-1, Fanatic-1, DV-1, EH-1, F6-6, DWatch-4, GIL/B-2, SST-1, Prime Wardens-5, Knyfe-1, Kvothe-1, TNat-3, Santa Guise-1, SI-1, HN-1, CR-1, Se-4)
  • Promo Villains - 8 (Omni, BB, Spite, Gloom, 2 each)
 
Total: 2,407

posts.name: Ronway
posts.cooked: It looks like you counted Celestial Tribunal as an environment from Villains rather than being a mini-expansion. It also list 4 mini-expansion heroes, which there is only 3 (Unity, The Scholar, and Guise). Likewise, it only has 3 Villain mini-expansions instead of the 4 (Ambusade, Miss Information, Wager Master, and Chokepoint) that currently exist. Unless of course you intentially excluded Miss information, which I totally would!
